title: credit.depleted payload v1
description: A draw took the holder's available balance of a feature from above zero to zero or below ("pack used up"). Made once per crossing. No postings: the draw's own event carries the balance move.

available.description: The holder's available balance of the feature after the mutation, in the feature's credits.

threshold.description: Always null: running out does not depend on the low-credit threshold.

previous_available.description: The available balance before the mutation (above `available`: these events come from a draw).
